Bakery

What MELARTION bakes

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Baklava and sweets

10 reviews mention the baklava, 3 the kataifi and 3 the orange cake. One guest calls the baklava crispy outside with soft, flaky layers.

Savoury pies

Halloumi and spinach pies, koupes and koulouri, fresh from the oven. One guest calls them the best savoury pies in the area.

Coffee and croissants

Guests sit down for a coffee with a croissant or a pastry. 3 reviews mention the croissants.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Always fresh

5 Google reviews mention the fresh pastries. One guest writes they are always fresh out of the oven.

Kind people

Guests describe the people working here as kind and welcoming.

A local gem

2 reviews mention local products, 2 the authentic taste. One guest calls it a little local gem and keeps coming back.

At the Larnaca market

At Nikolaou Rossou 24 in Larnaca, at the market. Open Monday to Thursday 7:30-18:00, Friday 7:30-19:00, Saturday 7:00-16:00, Sunday closed. Phone 97 658262.

What guests say

Three of 96 Google reviews, 90 of them with five stars.

“The baklava was absolutely delicious! It was perfectly crispy on the outside with soft, flaky layers inside.”
